'''Adine Canford''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. 

== Appearance ==
Adine is a plump [[Andoran]] with blue eyes and short black hair. 

==Abilities==
Adine is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. This is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]]. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong in the Power".{{ref/book|0|14}}

==History==
Adine is 95 years old. She was born in {{ne|905}} and she went to the [[White Tower]] in [[920 NE]]. After spending twelve years as a [[novice]] and eleven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in {{ne|943}}.

She becomes close friends with [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]] just after they are raised to the shawl. She was also friends with [[Leane Sharif]], who introduced them to one another. Moiraine places a level of trust in her, and thinks she is not at all arrogant "for an Andoran". 

She receives reports on behalf of Moiraine from her agents, including [[Nieda Sidoro]].

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] during the split with the White Tower. She taught novice classes.
